purpose: Present one condition as enough for the desired result.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
Noun + さえ + conditional ば; verb stem + さえすれば
As long as I have time, I can help.
You will be all right as long as you take this medicine.
As long as I know the way, I can go by myself.
formation: Noun + さえ + conditional ば; verb stem + さえすれば
restrictions: Other requirements are treated as unimportant or already satisfied.
mistake: The condition must be framed conditionally, not as a simple affirmative statement.
